info.name: PioneerX AI API v1.5
info.description:
PioneerX AI API Collection — Backend v1.5+ (synced with Nest controllers + Admin Panel).

Recent updates (pricing / credits / admin):
- GET /billing/plans — public website pricing table (amount + compareAtAmount crossed-out price)
- Billing checkout/portal/payments + Stripe webhook
- Admin Stripe price map CRUD (/admin/stripe-prices) with compareAtAmount
- Admin credit configs now include dailyImageLimit (images/day; quotas retired)
- Admin quota-configs endpoints DISABLED (use Credits + dailyImageLimit instead)
- Public GET /promo-codes for website promo list
- Admin site-pages + public GET /site-pages
- Admin dashboard-stats + payments list
- Image generate: dailyImageLimit read from CreditConfig (not QuotaConfig)

Default {{url}}: http://localhost:8010/api/v1

§18 Chat sessions: POST /conversations/session/reset after login; POST /saved-outputs/:id/open to restore; Save updates same item when continuing.

request.description:
Sends a magic link login email. If user does not exist, creates account with 3-day trial. Always returns { message: 'Check your email' }.

v1.5: Body also accepts optional "promoCode" (string). If provided and the account is new, the promo trial is applied at signup.

query.description: The token received in the magic link email

request.description: Verifies magic link token and issues JWT access + refresh tokens. Token expires in 15 minutes and is single-use.
Redirects the user to Google OAuth consent screen. Open this in a browser, not Postman.

Google redirects here with ?code=… after consent. Backend exchanges the code, issues JWTs, then 302-redirects to FRONTEND_URL/auth/google/callback?access_token=…&refresh_token=…

Open in a browser (not Postman). Ensure GOOGLE_CALLBACK_URL matches Google Cloud Console.
Redirects to Apple Sign In. Requires APPLE_* env vars. Open in a browser.
Apple posts identity token here. Backend runs oauthLogin and returns JWT tokens (JSON).

NEW in v1.5. Applies a promo code to the current (authenticated) user and extends/starts their trial by the code's trialDays.

Errors: 404 invalid code, 400 expired / max uses reached / already redeemed by this user.

item.name: Billing (Stripe)

request.description:
PUBLIC — used by the website pricing section.

Returns active StripePrice rows:
{
  priceId, tier, interval, label,
  amount,           // sale price in cents (e.g. 2999 = $29.99)
  compareAtAmount,  // crossed-out / “was” price in cents (nullable)
  currency
}

Website shows amount as the main price and compareAtAmount with line-through when set.

Auth required (user JWT).

Body (provide priceId OR tier+interval):
{
  "priceId": "price_xxx",   // optional — takes precedence
  "tier": "PRO",            // PRO | PRO_PLUS | ELITE
  "interval": "month"       // month | year
}

Returns: { url, sessionId, tier, interval } — redirect browser to url.
Auth required. Opens Stripe Customer Portal for the logged-in user. Returns { url }.
Auth required. Poll after returning from Stripe Checkout success page.
Auth required. Payment history for the current user.
Stripe → server webhook. Requires stripe-signature header in production. Do not call manually unless testing with Stripe CLI.

item.name: Image Generation

request.description:
Generates a logo or business card image.

Body:
- prompt: string (max 2000)
- type: "logo" | "business_card"
- sectionKey?: string — if set, also appends user + assistant messages to that section chat

Checks (in order):
1) CreditConfig.dailyImageLimit for the user's tier (null = unlimited) — 403 if exceeded
2) Credit balance (40 credits per image) — 402 if insufficient
Then: reserve → generate → confirm (refund on failure)

Returns: { imageUrl, creditStatus, … }
When sectionKey is set, chat history stores image-generation:{id}; use GET /image/generations/:id to reload full image.

exec: console.warn("Set image_generation_id (or run Generate Image with sectionKey first)");

item.description: v1.5 — image generation via Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash-image). Cost: 40 credits. Optional sectionKey appends the image into that section conversation (message stores image-generation:{id}; full base64 via GET /image/generations/:id).

item.name: Reviews

request.description: NEW in v1.5. PUBLIC endpoint (no auth). Returns approved reviews only, used by the landing page testimonials section.

NEW in v1.5. Authenticated user submits a review.

Body: { roleCompany?: string, reviewText: string, rating?: 1-5 }

One review per user — the reviewer name is taken from the user's account (not from the body). Submitting again UPDATES the existing review.

Reviews are AUTO-APPROVED and appear in GET /reviews immediately. Admin can hide one later via PATCH /admin/reviews/:id/reject.

item.description: NEW in v1.5 — real review system. Reviews go live immediately (auto-approved); admin can hide any review via reject.

item.name: Credit Configs

request.description:
Lists credit configs per tier:
{ id, tier, monthlyCredits, dailyCredits, trialCredits, dailyImageLimit }

All fields optional; send null to clear.

Fields:
- monthlyCredits — paid tiers (reset on billing cycle)
- dailyCredits — Free daily allowance
- trialCredits — daily while on trial (FREE row)
- dailyImageLimit — max images/day (null = unlimited; still costs 40 credits each). Applies immediately.
